findings.title: f5b0w RED/GREEN as written depends on parent settlement close and a nonexistent parent sentinel
findings.evidence: Parent settlement fixture.close dies at F5B_SETTLEMENT_PROFILE_SUCCESSOR_CODEC_REQUIRED over CERTIFIED_VALUE_MISMATCH before any durable hold. manualReviewHold, displacedControls and sameKeyReentry all call that close first. There is no exported parent settlement sentinel. The hold is reachable without a close through the closed f5b0u rebase-pair fixture.
findings.required_action: Keep f5b0w tests-only RED/GREEN on codec-free product sessions and real stores. Prove creator sealEpoch reaches the unchanged close owner and returns the existing parent terminus. Move successful close/adopt, cross-close reopen and removal/re-admission to parent f5b.

golden_path_fit: Prompt fail-closed issue, creator close not blocked by a hold, durable unfenced hold, and a store reverse-disposition/digest backstop are the smallest continuity prerequisite.
assessment: The API/authority/wire/crypto/threshold scope is sound, but the executable contract was circular. The exact-session terminal object counted four P2 findings without emitting their bodies; no un-emitted finding is invented here.
